fields.title: Your Trade Credentials Belong on Government Contracts.
fields.subtitle: Federal, state, and municipal infrastructure programs require thousands of verified tradesmen, heavy equipment operators, broadband technicians, and CDL drivers. EVOGovCon maps your skills directly to 6-digit federal NAICS codes and connects you with subcontractors and prime contractors—at zero cost.

fields.heading: How EVOGovCon Mobilizes Skilled Labor
fields.intro: Four steps from trade registration to prevailing-wage government contract placement.

steps.label: Create Your Trade Profile
steps.detail: Register your trade specialty, equipment credentials, OSHA/CDL certifications, and mobilization radius in under 5 minutes.

steps.label: Get NAICS-Matched
steps.detail: Our taxonomy engine maps your trade to official 6-digit federal NAICS codes used on SAM.gov, DOT, BEAD, and DoD contracts.

steps.label: Complete Readiness Track
steps.detail: Follow our step-by-step checklist for SAM.gov UEI registration, independent contractor setup, and safety compliance.

steps.label: Connect & Deploy
steps.detail: Certified subcontractors and prime contractors search by NAICS and certification to recruit you directly for active awards.

fields.heading: Supported Infrastructure & Trade Categories
fields.intro: Every trade category below is pre-mapped to official 2022/2026 U.S. Census & SBA 6-digit NAICS codes. Click any trade to initialize your worker profile with those NAICS codes pre-selected.

cards.title: Fiber & Broadband Installer
cards.body: OSP/ISP fiber optic splicing, OTDR testing, aerial strand/lashing, FTTH drops, and BEAD middle-mile deployment. Mapped to NAICS 237130, 517111, 238210.

cards.title: Cell Site & Tower Technician
cards.body: 5G macro tower rigging, PIM/sweep testing, microwave backhaul, DAS/small cell installation, and FirstNet public safety nodes. Mapped to NAICS 237130, 517112, 517810.

cards.title: HDD & Directional Boring
cards.body: Horizontal directional drilling, mud mixing, sonde locating, vibratory plowing, and hydro-excavation potholing. Mapped to NAICS 237130, 238910, 237110.

cards.title: Structured Cabling & Low Voltage
cards.body: Cat6A/fiber backbone, MDF/IDF rack buildouts,SCIF/federal facility cabling, access control, and IP surveillance. Mapped to NAICS 238210, 541513, 561621.

cards.title: Electrical & Power Systems
cards.body: Commercial/industrial power distribution, switchgear, substation wiring, backup generators, and airfield lighting. Mapped to NAICS 238210, 237130, 811310.

cards.title: Solar, EV Charging & Grid Tech
cards.body: Utility-scale solar PV arrays, NEVI Level 3 DC fast chargers, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and microgrids. Mapped to NAICS 237130, 238210, 221114.

cards.title: Underground Utilities & Pipe
cards.body: Water mains, storm/sanitary sewer trunk lines, duct banks, manhole setting, and municipal pipeline rehabilitation. Mapped to NAICS 237110, 237120, 237130.

cards.title: Highway, Street & Bridge Civil
cards.body: DOT roadway paving, bridge deck construction, guardrails, airport runways, and Work Zone traffic control. Mapped to NAICS 237310, 237990, 238910.

cards.title: CDL Trucking & Heavy Haul
cards.body: Class A/B commercial freight, lowboy equipment transport, aggregate dump trucking, water tankers, and hazmat logistics. Mapped to NAICS 484110, 484220, 484230.

fields.heading: Complete Skilled Labor NAICS Directory
fields.body: Filter by sector or search by code, trade keyword, or federal program (BEAD, IIJA, DOT, DoD, VA). Every code below is seeded in the EVOGovCon matching engine.
